what: A span's `item` is sometimes a value printed whole instead of a path: `{macro MacroCallId { loc: MacroCallLoc { def: MacroDefId { krate: Crate(Id(19460)), ...` for thousands of characters, twice a second, in every `Now`.
cost: transcripts of a cold build are mostly these; the screen cuts it to its first word
cause: a Debug of a macro file id where a name was meant (`file_item_tree_query`)
fix: the span names the macro by its path
